label: H.R. 5282
title: Reauthorizing Support and Treatment for Officers in Crisis Act of 2025

items.snippet: This bill reauthorizes through FY2029 grants for state and local law enforcement agencies and other organizations to provide family support services and mental health services to law enforcement personnel.

R000610.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
R000610.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
R000610.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
